idea: Replace the daily standup meeting with an async, five-minute-max written update each person posts every morning in one channel, plus a short auto-generated digest that surfaces only genuine blockers so nobody has to read every update to find them.
source: hand-authored by Claude Sonnet 5, offline in this session, by-layer Slicer variant -- see foundry/tools/slicer.yaml

pieces.text: Most team members will actually write a five-minute-max update every morning without a live meeting forcing the habit.
A short automated digest can reliably tell a genuine blocker apart from routine status text, without missing real blockers or crying wolf on false ones.
If the digest sometimes misses a real blocker, people will stop trusting it and go back to reading every update anyway, erasing the time saved.
The async format is worth switching to mainly because it removes a synchronous meeting that doesn't work well across time zones -- if the team is co-located, most of this benefit disappears.
Managers who relied on the live meeting to sense team mood and catch problems early will get equivalent signal from the async format.
